page.overview:
Who is Talga Lehlin?

Talga Lehlin was the ealdorwoman of a settlement near Novigrad. After a doppler, Forst Bolin, killed her daughter and other townspeople's relatives, she put out a contract for him to be brought in alive to face trial according to their customs.

Her contract was noticed by Geralt and Ciri, who soon arrived on her doorstep with a young woman, Jayne, in tow. Geralt, after confirming Talga as the one who issued the contract, informed her they'd brought him in alive. He then turned to Jayne, forcing her to transform, revealing Jayne was actually Forst.

With that, Geralt left it to Talga to deal with per their customs, though heavily implied the town should likely just kill him. After the witchers left, Talga confronted the doppler with others who had lost loved ones due to his killings and told him to prepare to stand trial. Category:Humans
